dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with consistent pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, excluding the central ridge shadow.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast linear markings visible on the posterior-right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings or rake-like scars on the posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge exhibiting a distinct shadow-cast along the mid-axis.
